notes:
### Fixed

- **Bass and treble follow the station again on a stopped set.** They are kept per station and always were, but they were only loaded when the radio was playing, so choosing a station while stopped left the sliders showing the station before it.
- That reading was wrong and acting on it was worse: one nudge of either slider wrote both displayed values through to the new station, quietly replacing its own.
- The volume is remembered as it always was, and still is. It was checked alongside these.
